dogecoin.text: So for the time being, #Dogecoin is the better meme coin to invest your $1,000 in compared to #Shiba Inu.

In contrast, Bitcoin's price will probably continue to trend upward over the long term thanks to its halving schedule. So, assuming the correlation with #Dogecoin persists for another 10 years, there will be an upward pressure on Doge's price whenever Bitcoin gets harder to mine.
